title: Toeplitz Matrix
description:
You are given a matrix matrix of size m × n.

A matrix is called Toeplitz if:

Every diagonal (from top-left to bottom-right) has the same value

Your task:

Return true if the matrix is Toeplitz
Otherwise, return false

Example 1
Input:
[[1,2,3,4], [5,1,2,3], [9,5,1,2]]

Output: true

Example 2
Input:
[[1,2], [2,2]]

Output: false

Constraints:

1 <= m, n <= 20
0 <= matrix[i][j] <= 99
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
